baseline_note: range-pruned copies the complete Criterion new directories from pruning-only runs; range-scan-before is saved by Criterion. All before runs already contain word materialization. No simultaneous task-owned heavy builds during sampling.

memory.method: Three alternating runs per binary using /usr/bin/time -l <binary> --test range_scan_layouts; includes all fixture setup. These compare pruning only with pruning plus cursor, not with the initial unpruned code. No task-owned concurrent heavy build.
